bonusFaqs.title: Frequently asked questions
bonusFaqs.answer1: The Deposit Bonus is additional trading credit awarded on your first qualifying deposit into a Bonus Account. It is intended to support your trading activity in accordance with the promotion's terms.
bonusFaqs.question2: How much bonus can I receive?
bonusFaqs.answer2: You will receive a 100% Deposit Bonus of up to $1,000. Example: Deposit $1,000 and receive an additional $1,000 in bonus credit.
bonusFaqs.question3: Does the bonus apply to every deposit?
bonusFaqs.answer3: No. The bonus is available only on the first qualifying deposit made into a Bonus Account.
bonusFaqs.question4: What is the minimum deposit required?
bonusFaqs.question5: How do I claim the bonus?
bonusFaqs.answer5: Simply open a new Bonus Account and make your first qualifying deposit to receive the bonus.
bonusFaqs.question6: Can I withdraw the bonus credit?
bonusFaqs.question7: Can I lose the bonus credit?
bonusFaqs.answer7: No. Bonus credit cannot be lost.
bonusFaqs.question8: What leverage is available on the Bonus Account?
bonusFaqs.answer8: You can trade with leverage of up to 1:400.
